BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

Section 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by the changing all of the C1-1 Neighborhood
Commercial District Symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 5-H in the area
bound by:

North Branch of the Chicago River; North Ashland Avenue; West Webster Avenue;
Chicago and Northwestern Railroad right-of-way; and a line 180.84 feet running
perpendicular to West Webster Avenue to the North Branch of the Chicago River.

to those of C2-1 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District.

Section 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage
and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 2200 N. Ashland Avenue, Chicago, Illinois.
